speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing weakness and fatigue; to better understand your condition, could you tell me how long these symptoms have been occurring and if anything seems to make them better or worse?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your recent outdoor activities and history of illnesses, have you noticed any specific symptoms like fever, chills, muscle pain, or changes in your urine color? Also, have you had any blood drawn recently?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: That diplopia is a critical new detail; has it been present since the onset of fatigue, and do you experience any difficulty swallowing or speaking? speaker: Doctor
text: Since your potassium and thyroid levels are normal, do you experience double vision that improves when you close one eye, and have you noticed any muscle weakness in your limbs or difficulty chewing? REQUEST TEST: Creatine_Phosphokinase.
